$comment: Description import and FBD export (feature 004, User Stories 4 and 5): the File > Import and File > Export entries, the import dialog, the export prompt and the status messages. Feature catalogue merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

importDescription.description: Import the description of another FictionBook file into this document

exportFbd.description: Write the description of this document, with its cover, as an FBD file

importMarkdown.description: Make a new book from a Markdown file: its headings become sections, its pictures and notes come along

exportMarkdown.description: Write the book as one Markdown file, its pictures embedded

exportMarkdownZip.description: Write the book as a ZIP archive holding a Markdown file and its pictures
